競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: ハウメット・エアロスペース

relations.text: Howmetの外部売上の約11%がGE Aerospace向け(2025年)
relations.text_en: GE Aerospace was about 11% of Howmet's third-party sales in 2025

source.label: Howmet Aerospace 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In 2025, RTX Corporation and GE Aerospace each represented approximately 11% of the Company's third-party sales.

relations.text: Woodwardの最大級の顧客で、戦略的な合弁も組んでいる
relations.text_en: One of Woodward's largest customers, with a strategic joint venture

source.label: Woodward 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: We have also partnered with our customers in the past, such as our strategic joint venture with one of our largest customers, GE Aerospace.

companies.name: バークシャー・ハザウェイ(PCC)

relations.text: 傘下のPrecision Castpartsの主要顧客の一社
relations.text_en: A significant customer of its Precision Castparts unit

source.label: Berkshire Hathaway 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: PCC has several significant customers, including aerospace original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") (Boeing and Airbus) and aircraft engine manufacturer suppliers (GE Aerospace, Rolls Royce and Pratt & Whitney).

companies.name: パーク・エアロスペース

relations.text: Parkの売上の約39%がGE Aerospaceの部品供給網向け
relations.text_en: About 39% of Park's sales go to GE Aerospace's supply chain

source.label: Park Aerospace 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: Customers - Net sales to affiliate and non-affiliate subtier suppliers of GE Aerospace were 39.3 %, 39.8 %, and 37.7 % of the Company's total worldwide sales in the 2026, 2025, and 2024 fiscal years, respectively.

relations.text: GEなどのエンジンメーカーがアフターサービスを委託する大口顧客
relations.text_en: Engine makers including GE subcontract aftermarket work to it

source.label: StandardAero 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Aircraft engine OEMs, including GE Aerospace, CFM International, Rolls-Royce, Honeywell, Pratt & Whitney and Safran in addition to providing authorizations to service the engines they manufacture, are also significant customers as a result of subcontracting aftermarket services to us for contracts they have with their end customers.

relations.text: GEと顧客の航空会社向けに予備エンジンのサービスを提供
relations.text_en: Provides spare engine services to GE for its airline customers

source.label: AerCap 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We have longstanding relationships and contractual commitments with approximately 150 customers, including the two largest manufacturers of commercial aviation engines, GE Aerospace and CFMI, to which we provide spare engines services for their airline customers.

companies.name: トライアンフ・グループ

relations.text: TriumphがOEM顧客の一社としてGE Aerospaceを挙げる
relations.text_en: Triumph lists GE Aerospace among its OEM customers

source.label: Triumph Group 10-K(2025年3月期)
source.quote: Our OEM customers, which include Boeing, Airbus, BAE, Bell Helicopter, Bombardier, GE Aerospace, Gulfstream, Honeywell, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, RTX Corporation, Rolls Royce and Sikorsky

relations.text: 民間エンジン事業の主な顧客(機体メーカー)
relations.text_en: A main airframer customer of the commercial engines business

source.label: GE Aerospace 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our CES customers for equipment and services consist primarily of airframers and airlines, including both Boeing and Airbus, and third-party MRO shops, to whom we sell spare parts and license MRO technology.

relations.text: 民間エンジン事業の主な顧客(機体メーカー)
relations.text_en: A main airframer customer of the commercial engines business

source.label: GE Aerospace 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our CES customers for equipment and services consist primarily of airframers and airlines, including both Boeing and Airbus, and third-party MRO shops, to whom we sell spare parts and license MRO technology.

relations.text: LEAPエンジンのCFMインターナショナルを50対50で共同保有
relations.text_en: Co-owns CFM International, maker of the LEAP engine, 50-50

source.label: GE Aerospace 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the most significant of which is CFM International, a 50-50 non-consolidated joint venture with Safran Aircraft Engines, a subsidiary of Safran Group of France.

relations.text: 知的財産のクロスライセンス契約を結び、Baker HughesはGEを供給元とする
relations.text_en: Cross-licenses intellectual property; Baker Hughes relies on GE Aerospace as a supplier

source.label: Baker Hughes 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The partial or complete loss of GE Vernova or GE Aerospace as suppliers, as well as contracts with our Aero JV with GE Vernova, may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

relations.text: 無人機向け小型エンジンGEK800を共同開発・生産するチーム契約(2025年6月)
relations.text_en: Teaming agreement (June 2025) to develop and field the GEK800 small engine for unmanned aircraft

source.label: Kratos 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The teaming agreement expands on the MOU and provides the framework for Kratos and GE Aerospace to develop, manufacture, test, and field the GEK800 engine

companies.name: ベータ・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: 出資者であり、ハイブリッド電動タービン発電機を共同開発
relations.text_en: An investor that co-develops a hybrid electric turbogenerator with it

source.label: BETA Technologies S-1/A(2025年10月)
source.quote: We are also partnering with General Electric Company, operating as GE Aerospace ("GE Aerospace"), to co-develop a hybrid electric turbogenerator, specifically designed for defense and civil applications.

relations.text: KC-135の操縦席改修でGEと独占的に協業するチーム契約
relations.text_en: Exclusive teaming agreement with GE Aerospace for the KC-135 center console refresh

source.label: Merlin S-1(2026年4月)
source.quote: We have a Teaming Agreement (the " Teaming Agreement ") with GE Aerospace (" GEAS ") that creates an exclusive collaboration

companies.name: イノベーティブ・ソリューションズ&サポート

relations.text: ISSCが10-Kで、主な競合の一社としてGE Aerospaceを挙げる
relations.text_en: IS&S names GE Aerospace among its principal competitors

source.label: Innovative Solutions & Support 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: With respect to our products, the Company's principal competitors include Honeywell Aerospace, Collins Aerospace, GE Aerospace, Thales Defense & Security, Inc., Elbit Systems and Garmin Ltd.

relations.text: KULRが10-Kで、振動解析分野の競合としてGEの回転翼機診断システムを挙げる
relations.text_en: KULR names GE Aerospace's RADS rotorcraft diagnostics as a competitor

source.label: KULR Technology 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Competitors: ● GE Aerospace RADS Division: GE's Rotorcraft Airframe Diagnostic System (RADS) offers state-of-the-art vibration analysis and diagnostics.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
